verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is downloadable at https://clerk.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). Content pulled from that spec describes real API features such as allow-lists and block-lists, which shows it is a substantive spec rather than a stub. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec's scope (e.g., Backend vs Frontend API coverage) and versioning.
